scope: Fresh-context visual audit of all108 native layouts from14 unique templates, using only verified-coverage.json and each referenced PNG.
decision: Withheld: unresolved visual concerns and image/dense-content/source-fidelity coverage gaps.
limitations: No repository code, source PPTX, unfiltered coverage, prior reviews or cause investigation read.
No causal diagnosis of renderer, template, routing code or skill behavior is supported by this restricted visual audit.
Contrast findings are visually confirmed concerns, not formal WCAG ratio measurements.
Image placeholders in modern1/2/6 were not populated; empty image regions are probe coverage gaps, not established renderer losses.
Short generic probes do not approve dense payload, long titles, Unicode, charts, populated footer/date/page fields or discriminated column routing.
Visible artwork described independently per layout; source-equivalence cannot be proven without source comparison.
